procedure: Holm step-down adjusted p values with monotone cumulative maximum
primary_family: nine population sign tests over N=6 through 14, corrected separately within each registered condition
S_e_condition_families: each frozen perturbation has its own nine-N Holm family; the frozen four-of-five survival rule prevents post-outcome condition selection
specificity_family: sixteen one-sided paired sign tests comparing N=14 with every other N in 4 through 20
local_parent_p_values: not multiplicity-adjusted because they feed the preregistered UI summary and are not standalone claims
